# ANALYSIS: STAGE-1_BACKTEST_GRINDER_RUN

**Filed:** 2026-08-24

**Type:** analysis

## Hypothesis

We need to run a Stage-1 backtest via the autoresearch grinder to compute edge_capture and wide_pnl for a set of candidate strategies, then conduct walk-forward OOS and real-fills checks to validate robustness.

## Mechanism

The autoresearch grinder will iterate over a predefined grid of strategy parameters (e.g., trigger variations, filter changes, exit changes) and compute OP-16 edge_capture on the J anchor days. After computing edge_capture and wide_pnl, we will perform walk-forward out-of-sample testing on a held-out window and real-fills checks on the top 3 J days using realistic OPRA simulation.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (as per OP-20).
2. **Sample bias:** The grinder will test a predefined parameter grid; sample size depends on grid dimensions; overfit risk mitigated by walk-forward OOS and real-fills checks.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window to be conducted after Stage-1).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (realistic OPRA simulation on top 3 J days to be conducted after Stage-1).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day could be a large loss if the strategy fails to skip J losers; max drawdown could exceed 50% of account; blow-up scenario involves repeated losses on J loser days.
6. **Concentration:** To be determined after Stage-1; if top-5 days exceed 100% of P&L, will disclose.

## Pre-merge gate

Grinder must complete Stage-1 backtest, produce edge_capture and wide_pnl; then walk-forward OOS must show positive edge_capture and WF ratio >= 0.70; real-fills must show <20% deviation from BS sim on top 3 J days; all gym validators must pass.
